player_prompt.intro:
Uri gukina Mastermind.
Ugomba kumenya kodi iyobora {code_length} tarakimu, tarakimu runaka kuva 1 hadi {num_numbers}, {repeats}.
Mu ntangiriro wawe, unashobora kubika ugushaka kwawe mu kibanzo gikurikira: '[2 1 4 5]'.
Nyuma ya kugushaka, uzabasha kubona ibibazo mu kibanzo gitsindika na pegs za blaki na white.
Pegs ya blaki inaashirira tarakimu nguhu mu ngo zihuza, ikaba pegs ya white inaashirira tarakimu nguhu mu ngo zidashobora.
Ugomba {max_turns} turns kugushaka kodi.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ntiwigeze utanga urutonde rw'imibare ya telefoni iri hagati y'inyuguti, ishyiritswe mu nkingi.
invalid_move.not_integers: Ibivugwa byose bigomba kuba ari imibare yose.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Imibare yose igomba kuba iri hagati ya 1 na {num_numbers}.
invalid_move.repeated_guess: Wamaze gutora {guess}. Gerageza utore ikindi gitekerezo.

game_action.feedback: Submitted [{guess}]. Feedback: {black_pegs} black peg(s), {white_pegs} white peg(s).

outcome.win: Uzanye kodi, wakuyehoje {black_pegs} kuri {code_length} pegs nguhu
outcome.turn_limit: Turn limit reached. You guessed {percent} percent of the numbers correctly.
